meta.name: animate-avatar
meta.description: Generate animated videos from static avatar images using FAL AI. Create looping work and relax animations with Kling V2.6 Pro, LTX, or Veo models.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态头像变成循环动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让静态头像变成灵动动画
copy.tagline_en: Turn static avatars into looping animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring a static avatar to life with animation

howto.what: 把静态头像图片变成循环播放的小动画视频。默认每个头像生成3段:2段工作、1段放松,并压缩为320x320的MP4短片。
howto.when: 当用户给出头像图片并要求生成动画视频,或提到制作工作/放松类头像动画时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这张头像生成为3段动画,2段工作加1段放松
say.note: 默认生成3个视频并压缩

say.text: 用 Kling 模型做一段头像打字的循环动画
say.note: 选择 kling 模型生成工作动画

say.text: 给这张头像做一段喝咖啡的放松动画,并优化文件大小
say.note: 生成放松动画并压缩到目标体积

howto.what_en: Turns a static avatar image into short looping animated videos. By default creates 3 clips per avatar (2 work, 1 relax) and compresses them to 320x320 MP4 files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to animate a static avatar image, or requests work/relax avatar videos.

say_en.text: Turn this avatar into 3 animations: 2 work, 1 relax.
Make a looping typing animation for this avatar with Kling.
say_en.note: Uses the kling model for a work clip.

say_en.text: Create a relaxing coffee-drinking loop for this avatar and optimize it.
say_en.note: Creates a relax clip and reduces file size.
